title: Earthy Smoky Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Tender beef skewers with a smoky and creamy flavor, featuring Thai sweet basil and caramelized onions, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to desired doneness
While the skewers are cooking, caramelize the onions in a pan with a little olive oil over low heat
Stir in the chopped Thai sweet basil and cook for an additional minute
Serve the skewers with a dollop of sour cream and a spoonful of the caramelized onion and basil mixture
